 Subscribe to skip ads Advertisement News All Good Presents Issues 4848 Festival Save the Date, All Good Now Will Take 2027 Off
 RS By Relix Staff 10:24 AM EST on November 13, 2026 
 All Good Presents has announced that their 4848 Festival will return to Snowshoe Mountain Resort in Snowshoe, West Virginia, from July 15-17, 2027. The event’s eighth-annual edition will once again take place at an elevation of 4,848 feet, with the full artist lineup set to be revealed on Friday, December 4, followed by tickets going on sale Friday, December 11.
 Dark Star is for Kids T-Shirt
 $24.95
 Shop Now Along with the announcement, All Good Presents has confirmed that the All Good Now concert, the reimagined version of the All Good Music Festival & Campouts held in at Columbia, MD’s Merriweather Post Pavilion in 2025 and 2026, will take 2027 off. 
 “We take the curating of our festivals very seriously,” All Good Presents founder Tim Walther said in a statement. “We meticulously program our festivals from the headliner down to the first act of the day with the intention of building the most epic lineup possible based on emerging, established and genre busting artists. Transparently, the lineup was not developing to our standards this year, so we have decided to pause Now and return when all of the stars are in alignment. We understand that many may be disappointed, but this scene is flourishing, the fans are as loyal and feverish as ever and the right time will come for All Good Presents to bring that festival energy back to Merriweather Post.”
 Walther announced the lineup for All Good Presents’ Dark Star Jubilee earlier this week .
